rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is excessively proud of themselves.

example.english: They are arrogant all the time and look down on people.
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zi6 daai6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the arrogance comes across as rude, cheeky, or dismissive in interaction.

example.english: You do not have to be so arrogant; everyone was just asking.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁串，大家只係問下啫。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 cyun3 daai6 gaa1 zi2 hai6 man6 haa5 ze1

rows.note: Use this when the person is openly overbearing or brazen, especially while flaunting power or success.

example.english: As soon as they won the match, they became arrogant and showed off everywhere.
example.traditional: 佢一贏咗場比賽就變到好囂張，周圍晒命。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 jeng4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3 zau6 bin3 dou3 hou2 hiu1 zoeng1 zau1 wai4 saai3 ming6

rows.note: Use this to stress that the person treats other people as beneath notice.

example.english: After being promoted to manager, they became arrogant and acted as if their colleagues were invisible.
example.traditional: 佢升咗做經理之後，目中無人，見到同事都當睇唔到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5 zi1 hau6 muk6 zung1 mou4 jan4 gin3 dou2 tung4 si6 dou1 dong3 tai2 m4 dou2
